critique.evidence: The oversized “Map the adversary before scoring it” thesis and cyan-linked kill-chain path give the desktop view a recognizable visual concept beyond a routine dashboard. However, the dominant lower area returns to familiar dark cards, tabs, badges, and a JSON inspector. On tablet and mobile, the signature path becomes a plain numbered stage grid, so the most distinctive idea does not survive responsively.
critique.fix: Make the kill-chain map the unmistakable hero at every viewport: preserve a compact connected-path visualization on tablet/mobile, animate or visually trace the selected vector through stages, and tie the cards and detail pane to that route with stronger spatial highlighting instead of generic columns and raw JSON.
